title: CLEANUP: _POSIX_C_SOURCE defined after system headers in wp11_test_keystore.c
description: test/wp11_test_keystore.c line 36 defines _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200112L after #include <sys/stat.h> and #include <unistd.h> on lines 34-35. Per POSIX, feature-test macros must be defined before any system header is included or they have no effect. The define is a no-op and is misleading. Fix: move #define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200112L to before all includes (line 1 after the comment block), or remove it if it is not needed by any function in the test file. Add a one-line comment if keeping it: '/* Must appear before any system header. */'
